note: Natural-ratio collage. The equal 4:3 plate cropped nothing but letterboxed everything — measured at 1440px, a 420x315 cell holding a 420x280 photograph, 89 per cent filled, with empty plate under every landscape picture. One level of CSS multi-column replaces it, so a landscape photograph reads wide and a portrait one reads tall. object-fit:cover was removed from its owners in archive-system.css and design-refinements.css rather than overridden again in the museum layer, which also let one !important go.
